mapper.select:
SELECT p.id AS postId, m.id AS memberId, m.name AS memberName, m.unique_id AS uniqueId, m.profile_image AS profileImageUrl, p.content AS content,
-- 대표 이미지 ( SELECT pi.image_url FROM post_image pi WHERE pi.post_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.image_order ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS mainImageUrl,
p.like_count AS likeCount,
-- 댓글 수 ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reply r WHERE r.post_id = p.id AND r.hidden = FALSE ) AS commentCount,
-- 내가 좋아요를 눌렀는지
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_like pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.id AND pl.member_id = #{memberId} ) AS likedByMe,
FALSE AS likedByMe,
p.subscriber_only AS subscriberOnly, p.created_at AS createdAt
FROM post p
JOIN member m ON m.id = p.member_id
WHERE p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND p.subscriber_only = FALSE
AND ( p.subscriber_only = FALSE
OR p.member_id = #{memberId}
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM subscription s WHERE s.member_id = #{memberId} AND s.creator_id = p.member_id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' ) )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM block b WHERE ( b.member_id = #{memberId} AND b.blocked_id = p.member_id ) OR ( b.member_id = p.member_id AND b.blocked_id = #{memberId} ) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follow f WHERE f.member_id = #{memberId} AND f.target_id = p.member_id )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM subscription s WHERE s.member_id = #{memberId} AND s.creator_id = p.member_id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' )
AND p.id < #{cursorId}
ORDER BY p.id DESC
LIMIT #{size}
